response.rationale: Erdheim-Chester disease is characterized by foamy histiocytes, Touton-like giant cells, symmetric osteosclerosis, and CD68+/CD163+/factor XIIIa+ with CD1a/S100/langerin negativity, matching all key findings. Rosai-Dorfman typically shows S100 positivity and emperipolesis, absent here. Langerhans cell histiocytosis requires CD1a/langerin positivity, which is explicitly negative.

rejected.why: Negative CD1a, S100, and langerin excludes Langerhans cell histiocytosis.
S100 negativity and lack of emperipolesis or typical RDD features; only foamy histiocytes are nonspecific.
